==================================================
ABOUT VELMORA NOW
==================================================

Velmora Now is a free online platform offering browser-based health calculators,
image tools, QR code generators, converters, and productivity utilities.

Website URL:
https://www.velmoranow.in

The platform is designed for users who want:
- Fast online tools
- Privacy-focused utilities
- No signup requirements
- Mobile-friendly calculators
- Instant browser-based processing

All tools run fully in the browser.
No files or personal data are uploaded or stored on servers.

Velmora Now primarily serves Indian users but is globally accessible.

==================================================

- Health calculators are informational only.
- Tool outputs are not medical advice.
- QR codes generated do not expire because of the platform.
